tables.name: pages
tables.label: Pages
tables.description: Idea pages. A page has a title and a written body, can nest inside another page, and carries its own diagram.

tables.name: links
tables.label: Links
tables.description: Wiki-link edges parsed from page bodies by the engine: fromId -> toId, one row per [[target]] found in a page's body. toId is the resolved target page id (empty when unresolved); toTitle keeps the raw [[target]] text so a later rename can re-resolve the link.

tables.name: bubbles
tables.label: Bubbles
tables.description: Bubble-board items. Each bubble belongs to one page's board (the page column).

tables.name: bubble_links
tables.label: Bubble links
tables.description: Lines between bubbles on one page's board (the page column).

tables.name: grafts
tables.label: Also filed under
tables.description: Extra places a page is filed: fromId is the branch page, toId the page that also appears under it (type graft). A page's parentId stays its one home; these rows add more places without moving it, and are never touched by the wiki-link index.
